title: CLTR Cutover schema-package manifest
description: Governs manifest.json, the deterministic tamper-evidence and completeness manifest over schemas/cltr_cutover's own schema resource files (Phase 136H, CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.41's manifest-integrity requirement, deferred from 136F Sec.13 to this phase). Sits at the package root, outside shared/, since it describes the package itself rather than a reusable $def any record schema references. Scoped, in this phase, to the 7 shared-core resources only -- it carries no entry for any records/*.schema.json file, none of which exists yet.

contract_version.description: The governing contract and version this manifest was generated against.

package.description: The schema package this manifest indexes.

entries.description: One entry per schema resource file in the package, in deterministic canonical order (sorted by file_path, ascending, ASCII byte order).

schema_id.description: Must match the entry's own schema file's declared $id exactly.

schema_version.description: Must match the entry's own schema file's declared schema_version (once a records/*.schema.json file carries one in its own content; shared/ files record their intended version here directly, since shared/ files carry no in-document schema_version field of their own).

file_path.description: Path relative to the cltr_cutover package root. Forbids '..' and leading '/' by construction (neither character sequence needed nor permitted by the pattern's charset for a traversal to succeed, and the loader additionally verifies containment independent of this pattern).

file_digest.description: SHA-256 of the entry's own schema file's raw bytes -- a tamper-evidence mechanism over the schema files themselves, distinct from any future record's own record_digest.

family.description: The record_type value the file governs, or 'shared' for shared/ files.

implementation_group.description: Implementation group per CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.46. Every entry in this phase's manifest is group 1.

dependencies.description: The entry's own $ref targets, by $id. Empty array permitted for a file with no local dependency.

status.description: 'frozen' marks authoring-complete content committed for the registry to load; 'draft' is reserved for uncommitted, in-progress content and must never appear in a committed manifest. 'frozen' does not itself assert independent verification has occurred -- 136H's own entries are 'frozen' at authoring completion, and their independent verification is 136I's separate responsibility.
